title: Play-Nice Global Agent-Work Configuration
description: User-level configuration for the `playnice` work-entry orchestrator. Defaults are conservative; the owner opts into automation explicitly. Repositories consume the global system; they never silently weaken these floors.

freshness.description: Global floor for remote freshness. `require-current` gates every work permit on a verified authoritative remote revision; consumer manifests may raise the floor but cannot lower it.

reconcile_before_new_work.description: Fast-forward the default branch to its upstream ONLY when the working tree is clean. Diverged/dirty state is preserved, never destroyed.

merge_ready_pull_requests.description: Explicit opt-in: merge PRs whose objective readiness is proven (mergeable, checks green, review not required, not draft). Never merges on 'probably okay'.

close_proven_resolved_issues.description: Explicit opt-in: close issues only when a merged PR references close/fix/resolve #N.

remove_proven_merged_branches.description: Explicit opt-in: delete branches proven merged into the default branch with no open PR and no linked worktree. Unmerged branches are preserved.

path.description: Handoff file location. Empty = .project/HANDOFF.md when .project exists, else .agent/HANDOFF.md.

args.description: Adapter arguments before the task prompt. Provider-neutral: opencode, codex, kilo, aider, ...

verify_command.description: Shell command run after the agent exits (e.g. 'uv run pytest -q'). Empty = skip.

timeout_minutes.description: 0 = no timeout for the agent process.
